# Dharmendra Awasthi

> Lead Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, and Software Developer with 9+ years of experience specializing in Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, AWS, and Microservices Architecture.

## Professional Summary
Tech Lead with **10 years of experience** architecting distributed systems and cloud-native microservices across Fintech, Gaming, Telecom, and Retail. Proven track record of **leading engineering teams (4+)** and delivering event-driven platforms (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, AWS) scaling to **1,500+ TPS** and **10M+ users**.
